supplemental: ProcessSupervisor (procsupervisor.rs): POSIX process-group ownership (every spawn setsid's into its own group, pgid verified via getpgid; termination only ever fires killpg on a registered NON-TERMINAL record — the child is unreaped so the pid cannot have been recycled; no adoption API exists so a foreign leftover can never be mistaken for a managed process)

Bounded cleanup chain: mark Terminating + killpg(SIGKILL) atomically under the record lock -> bounded wait for the exit observation (default 5s; expiry = honest CleanupTimedOut, never a fabricated success) -> reaper-side reclamation (250ms bounded stdio grace because grandchildren may hold the pipe write ends; pump abort closes our read ends; pty master + spill closed; reclaimed recorded) -> settle into the bounded ring; tokio kill_on_drop is DISABLED and never the guarantee

Future-drop does not shed ownership: the executor's ProcessOwnershipGuard initiates terminate_detached (killpg fires synchronously from the Drop; the bounded tail runs on a supervisor-owned task) — the run's CALL-level cancellation tree drops the executor future at its await point and the cleanup still completes with receipts

Persistent terminals are EXPLICITLY registered (kind + owner): a run cancellation does not kill them (the tool call already returned running); they die on the explicit close path or the frozen application-exit policy shutdown_all (each bounded, each with an accurate receipt)

Env injection is EXPLICIT-whitelist only (PATH/HOME/LANG/LC_*/TERM/TZ/TMPDIR/SHELL) + bounded caller env (<=32 entries, size caps); the server's full environment (secrets) is never inherited — the incumbent env ?? process.env gap closed

Output bounds: rolling 100KiB window + head/tail truncation with the incumbent notice vocabulary + capped spill file surfaced as an Artifact ResourceRef; PTY transcript ring 256KiB with dropped-undelivered accounting; UTF-8 chunk boundaries handled by byte-offset cursor delivery

write_stdin authorization: handle format gate -> registered record -> must be PersistentTerminal -> owner (principal+session from the trusted RunContext) must match -> write/deliver; distinct stable codes for forged/unknown/not-interactive/not-owned; final drain works after exit, late writes fail honestly
